notes: Access route: direct HTTP and Playwright both blocked by Cloudflare Turnstile; Claude-in-Chrome (real Chrome session) passed the challenge and was used throughout (see bs169.json notes for full access detail). Found the genuine Clearance PLP via the site's own HTML sitemap (https://www.tavolashop.com/ae-en/sitemap.html), which lists 'Clearance' as a distinct named category alongside 'Deals', 'Bundle Offers', and 'Flash Sale'. Opened https://www.tavolashop.com/ae-en/clearance-sale: breadcrumb reads 'Home / Clearance', page <title> is 'Buy Clearance in UAE | Tavola', H1 is 'Clearance for sale in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, RAK, Umm Al Quwain and the UAE' -- unambiguous site-taxonomy match, no flag needed. Applied the Clearance-vs-Sale test to every other discount-style page on the site and excluded them: /deals (865 items, title 'Tavola Deals, Super Sale & Special Offers' -- a generic temporary-sale/discount landing page with no permanence signal, not clearance-worded); /deals/flash-sale ('Flash Sale' -- explicitly time-limited promo campaign); /bundle-offers (bundled-product deals, not markdown/outlet/end-of-line stock). Direct URL guesses /clearance, /outlet, and /deals/clearance all 404 -- the only working slug is /clearance-sale. Site search for 'clearance' redirected to a single unrelated product page ('simplehuman Butterfly Lid Bin, 30L is the only product matching your clearance search'), confirming no second Clearance listing exists elsewhere on the site.
